In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]] in order to investigate the disappearance of some of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia's]] people. They eventually discovered that [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] was behind the disappearance as the secret leader of the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]].
